setup.players: Two to four players. Two players receive six tiles each; three players six each; four players five each. Remaining tiles form the boneyard.
setup.deck: Double-six domino set (or larger set for variants).
setup.dealing: 2 players: 6 tiles each. 3 players: 6 each. 4 players: 5 each. Remaining tiles form the boneyard.

rules.objective: Score points by making the ends of the cross-shaped layout match; first player to reach 100 points wins the game.
rules.gameplay: One player leads a double as the spinner. Players must complete all four arms of the spinner before adding tiles to them. On your turn you may play a matching tile or draw from the boneyard until you can play or it is empty; if you can neither play nor draw, pass. Play until someone empties their hand (dominoes) or the game blocks.
keyRules: First double led is the spinner; all arms must be started before adding to any arm.
Draw from boneyard when unable to play; pass when unable to play and unable to draw.
Score after each play: pair of ends 2, triplet 3, quadruplet 4, quintuplet 5.
At round end deduct 1 point per tile left in hand; player who dominoes deducts nothing.

scoring.description: After each play, score for matching ends on the layout: pair 2, triplet 3, quadruplet 4, quintuplet 5. At round end deduct 1 per tile left in hand; dominoer deducts nothing. Game is 100 points.
